observations: body L1, L17: the 2 and the 6 of «٢٦١», «٢٦٧» (L1) and «٢٦٣» (L17) touch (5.6 points), as in «٢٦» on p. 326; the last digit of «٢٦٣» is 4.7 points wide (a 3).
body L2: «[سَادِسَة]» has no tanwīn, unlike the bracketed headwords [خَامِسَةٌ] on p. 331 and [سَابِعَةٌ] on p. 336.
body L5, L6: the headword «سطر» (L6) has no vowel signs; the mark above it is the kasra under the r of «سَرِيرٌ» (L5).
body L6, L7: the syllable «the» is printed twice at the break of «mathe-» (L6) and «thematicae» (L7); transcribed as printed.
body L7: the first digit of «٣٢» is 4.8 points wide (a 3), the second 3.0 points (a 2); both digits of «٣٣» measure 4.7-4.8 points.
body L10, L11: the kasra under the r of «المُشْتَرِك» (L10) is printed low, just above the b of «tabulis» (L11), as the kasra of المِرِّيخِ on p. 330.
body L16: «ἐκλίψεως» is printed without the ε of ἐκλείψεως, as on p. 336; transcribed as printed. «سُقُوطٌ» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L23: «الرُّؤُس» is printed with one wāw; its hamza is cast with the damma in one sort (3.7 by 5.2 points), the hamza of «الرَّأْس» with the sukūn (3.7 by 5.5 points).
body L26, L30: the alif of «الأُفْق» (L26) has the hamza with a damma and the fāʾ a sukūn, as on p. 330; «الافق» (L30) is unvowelled.
body L26: the dots in «سَمْت ... من» and in «directio ... in» are printed spaced; transcribed «...».

body L30, L35, L36: the hairlines of some letters did not print: the o of «ergo» (L30), of «aequinoctiali» and of the second «puncto» (L35) and of «tanto» (L36) shows two separate arcs, and the u of the first «puncto» (L35) is open at the bottom; transcribed as the letters.
body L36: a speck (0.6 point) is printed in the left margin before «(i. e.»; not transcribed.
notes_left L1: a speck (0.8 point) is printed against the opening parenthesis of «(1)»; not transcribed.

notes_left L4: «الرامى» is printed with a mīm and a final yāʾ without dots: the closed loop of the mīm and the bowl of the yāʾ differ from the isolated sīn of the small-type راس on p. 320. The text has سَمْت الرَّأْس for the zenith (body L23). Transcribed as printed.
notes_right L4: the dots of «...» are printed spaced; transcribed «...».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
